message.content: I’d recommend checking out **“Nomadland”** (2020). It’s a beautifully shot, contemplative film that won several major awards—including Best Picture at the Oscars—and has been praised for its storytelling, direction, and performances. Of course, “best” is always a matter of taste, so if you’re into something different—say, a thriller or a comedy—you might want to look at other standout films from that year as well.
